current_exact_blob_evidence.observed_behavior: Future implementation leaf is the exact Work Unit ID. Independent review leaf is literal review- plus exact ID. Current phase does not move workspaces.
Same future deterministic layout, with outside-repository ephemeral build/review output required.
Checks exact contract strings in schema/template/AGENTS/bootstrap. It does not construct or create worktrees.
Git --show-toplevel and Path.resolve establish physical identities and distinguish aliases. Invalid/missing/dirty/nonmatching role roots fail closed; no directory leaf generator or shortening.
Git commands are argument arrays. Canonical status uses core.autocrlf=false, UTF-8 surrogateescape decoding and NUL output. No worktree creation here.
Cleanup classification is read-only, uses resolve/lstat/namespace containment and rejects unsafe targets. It performs no deletion.
Uses actual Git worktree/index/untracked union and UTF-8 NUL paths; failed commands and unsafe paths yield explicit denial.
Governed entry applies identity, immutable WU scope, directory-prefix, role, revision, PRE and guardrail validation. No filesystem probe, root creation or absolute 240-character gate.
Sole durable instruction filename is a canonical UUID; compact sorted UTF-8 JSON with one LF, not a directory/ID sanitizer.
Rejects invalid, duplicate, absolute, drive-qualified, backslash or dot-component scope paths; does not rewrite them.
Path.resolve staging must be outside Management Repository or raises ProjectionValidationError. Nonempty staging rejected. Copies only manifest-relative files; no prefixing to ordinary checkout.
Explicit caller staging or tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=...) with no dir parameter. Delegates enforced separation to stage_consumer_projection; finally cleans only its temporary directory.
Consumer files staged in independent tempfile root, nested ZIP entry names are logical archive paths, not ordinary host paths.
CLI defaults output to root/dist and release metadata to root/releases. Current version 2.7.4 filenames are explicitly measured; future versions/outputs need per-operation remeasurement.
Verified Git artifact uses caller destination, basename only, hash/size checks and exclusive xb open. No nested relative archive path expansion at destination.
Generates releases/records/v<current-version>.json and releases/INDEX.json; current values are shorter than tracked maximum.
The explicit <=240 check limits an artifact locator repository-relative metadata string. It is not an absolute filesystem compatibility assertion.
Only test Git worktree add accepts an explicit reviewer path beneath TemporaryDirectory; symlink/junction alias handling is tested there.
Fixture root/owner/a bare repository and root/checkout clone are under caller temporary root; full UUID instruction evidence below temporary clone.
Copies full source tree under tempfile/framework excluding git/worktrees/dist. Added framework prefix belongs to temporary root.
Fixture writes relative CONTROL/STATE/work/navigation data to caller root; actual callers establish TemporaryDirectory, e.g. lines 1164-1166.
Frozen validator extraction/copy targets frozen_root from TemporaryDirectory; live ROOT is passed for read-only validator input.
Staging constants and management metadata fixture writes use TemporaryDirectory, not current repository root.
Synthetic .worktrees/branch/state.txt and projection fixture output under independent TemporaryDirectory.
Fresh release fixture copies source under tmp/framework; tests generate dist/release files in that copied tree or explicit temp output.
Actual source ROOT is a read input; generated package output_dir is Path(TemporaryDirectory), independently separated from ordinary tree.

A_Q_review.A_git_worktree_target: No production worktree-add generator. Actual tests pass an explicit path to Git. Installed git-worktree documentation specifies target <path>. Future exact full-ID layout is directly expressible by a caller.
A_Q_review.D_review_prefix: Literal review-, 7 characters, exact operating contracts checked by validate_framework.
A_Q_review.E_exact_ID_leaf: 83-character current maximum ID is used verbatim; no filename-derived ID assumptions.
A_Q_review.F_shortening: No required shortening, slugging, sanitizing or hash leaf. Canonical JSON hashes identify metadata and do not rename leaves.
A_Q_review.G_Windows_canonicalization: Path.resolve -> os.path.realpath; installed ntpath uses native _getfullpathname/_getfinalpathname, link resolution and error fallback. Existing candidate parent D:/ is not a reparse point.
A_Q_review.H_Git_paths: Argument arrays, --show-toplevel, NUL inventories, UTF-8 decoding, command-local EOL handling; invalid path/command results fail closed.
A_Q_review.I_Python_paths: Path/PurePosixPath joining; resolve normalizes absolute paths and aliases. Windows candidate strings normalized without shortening.
A_Q_review.J_validation_checkout: Tests create only independent TemporaryDirectory clones/copies/worktrees. Validation checkout is not ordinary leaf expansion.
A_Q_review.K_TEMP_TMP_TMPDIR: No framework override; installed tempfile order is TMPDIR,TEMP,TMP, platform defaults, finally cwd. Future heavy validation must bind and validate explicit outside-repository TEMP root. No gettempdir probe called in L2.
A_Q_review.L_fixture_outputs: All identified test writer roots are test-local temporaries or caller arguments supplied from temporaries; SOURCE ROOT is used as read input.
A_Q_review.M_ordinary_generated: Instruction UUID files, current evidence/result filenames, current dist/release filenames, Python __pycache__ and Git local metadata are independently measured below 122.
A_Q_review.N_external_generated: Projection rejects inside-root staging; release output caller destination and archive entry hierarchy are separate. Test copied-framework prefix and nested fixtures belong to external temporary root.
A_Q_review.O_explicit_240: Only production explicit 240 test found is result_return locator metadata validation. PRE conservatively applies accepted <=240 cap to actual absolute strings.
A_Q_review.P_MAX_PATH_policy: No production MAX_PATH or LongPathsEnabled override/assumption. Installed Git long path support disabled by default; conservative cap requires no policy change.
A_Q_review.Q_post_design_changes: All relevant source/test/schema/module/template/plugin/operating-contract blobs unchanged from accepted Design and Phase G baseline.

implementation_aware_review.scope_limit: Current inputs and proven required ordinary outputs only. New versions, IDs, tracked paths and generated outputs require accepted per-operation <=240 preflight.

ordinary_path_expansion.CURRENT_ORDINARY_PATH_EXPANSION_SOURCE: Exact current tracked-tree maximum; code/test callsite review establishes no required longer ordinary generated path.

external_temp_root_separation.error_paths: tempfile may fall back to cwd if every preferred external directory fails. L2 does not claim successful temporary-root allocation and does not invoke gettempdir (which writes a probe). Accepted future validation requires an explicitly external temp root; projection independently rejects inside-repository staging. No fallback root is silently accepted as an ordinary output.

git_installed_docs.facts: core.longpaths is disabled by default; builtin support above 260 is optional. Worktree target is explicit <path>; this PRE does not run worktree commands.

windows_tool_compatibility.current_names_compatibility: Current full-ID, review prefix, slug and maximum relative path are ASCII, no reserved device components, trailing dot/space, wildcard or invalid Windows character. Ordinary path cap is <=240 and does not rely on long-path opt-in.
windows_tool_compatibility.framework_validators: Read-only native validators use Path.resolve/read JSON, immutable Git refs and schema/role/scope checks. No full absolute 240 runtime gate; this PRE computes it.

authority_boundary: Proposed local decision only; no root binding, filesystem mutation, publication, durable L2 completion or L3 execution authority.
